description: Check XML against a pinned officialSchema package or supplied XSD 1.0/1.1. Imports resolve inside the selected package only. Returns bounded findings and original schema hashes. The mf-etransport-v2 package also runs original official Schematron 2.0.2, all phases, with separate metadata.

bankProfile.description: Optional ID from /bank-profiles.json; default generic-epc. Adds only the explicitly listed public-bank checks.

bankProfileVersion.description: Optional exact published profile version. An unavailable version fails closed.

include_guides.description: Include guide URLs in validation results.

max_findings.description: Maximum combined errors and warnings returned (1–100). Validation scope is unchanged.

officialSchema.description: Pinned official package ID from /official-schemas.json. Supply this instead of xsd/schemaFiles; the server selects the exact engine and records original hashes.

rootSchema.description: Required with schemaFiles; path of the entry XSD.

schemaFiles.description: Complete local XSD project: 1–100 files, at most 1 MiB per file and 10 MiB total. Supply rootSchema and omit xsd; imports/includes resolve only among these files.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 XSD text for this project file, at most 1 MiB. Imports/includes must reference supplied project files; no remote fetching.

path.description: Relative project path, for example schemas/types.xsd.

xml.description: Complete UTF-8 XML text, at most 10 MiB. DTDs and entities are blocked.

xsd.description: UTF-8 XSD text, at most 1 MiB. Use either xsd or schemaFiles. No remote fetching.

xsdVersion.description: XSD engine version: 1.0 (default) or 1.1. Choose 1.1 for schemas using assertions or other XSD 1.1 features.

name: validate_xml_against_xsd
title: Validate XML against XSD
